import pandas as pd

items = pd.read_csv("order_items.csv")
orders = pd.read_csv("orders.csv", parse_dates=["order_date"])
items["revenue"] = items["quantity"] * items["unit_price"] * (1 - items["discount"])
sales = items.merge(orders, on="order_id", how="left", validate="many_to_one")
sales = sales[sales["status"] != "cancelled"]
sales = sales.assign(year=sales["order_date"].dt.year, quarter=sales["order_date"].dt.quarter)
sales_2025 = sales[sales["year"] == 2025]

targets = pd.DataFrame({
    "channel": ["marketplace", "mobile_app", "web"],
    "Q1": [5000, 15000, 28000],
    "Q2": [5000, 16000, 30000],
    "Q3": [6000, 20000, 40000],
    "Q4": [9000, 30000, 60000],
})

grid = sales_2025.pivot_table(index="quarter", columns="channel", values="revenue", aggfunc="sum")

targets_long = targets.melt(id_vars="channel", var_name="quarter", value_name="target")
targets_long["quarter"] = targets_long["quarter"].str[1].astype(int)

actual = sales_2025.groupby(["channel", "quarter"], as_index=False)["revenue"].sum()
vs_target = targets_long.merge(actual, on=["channel", "quarter"], how="left", validate="one_to_one")

beat = int((vs_target["revenue"] >= vs_target["target"]).sum())
print(grid.round(0))
print(vs_target.round(0))

isinstance(targets_long, pd.DataFrame) and len(targets_long) == 12 and {'channel', 'quarter', 'target'} <= set(targets_long.columns) and sorted(set(targets_long['quarter'].tolist())) == [1, 2, 3, 4]
isinstance(vs_target, pd.DataFrame) and len(vs_target) == 12 and abs(float(vs_target['revenue'].sum()) - 326808) < 1
